metadata.citation: Natural Earth, free vector and raster map data, naturalearthdata.com (v5.1, accessed 2026-10-21)
metadata.processing: Natural Earth 10m admin-1 states/provinces, dissolved per country by {'GBR': 'geonunit', 'FRA': 'region', 'ESP': 'region', 'BEL': 'region', 'IRL': None, 'NLD': None, 'LUX': None, 'PRT': None} (None = NE units kept); clipped to lat 35..70 N, lon -50..10 E (shapely intersection); simplified (Douglas-Peucker, 0.01 deg, topology preserved); coordinates rounded to 3 decimals
